questions.question: The term of a member of the Lok Sabha is normally:
questions.explanation: A Lok Sabha term is normally 5 years.

questions.question: The national animal of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Royal Bengal Tiger is India’s national animal.

questions.question: The Khajuraho temples were built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: How many players are there in a kabaddi team on the court?
questions.explanation: A kabaddi team has 7 players on the court.

questions.question: The Jog Falls is located on which river?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls is on the Sharavati river in Karnataka.

questions.question: The Simon Commission came to India in:
questions.explanation: The Simon Commission arrived in 1928 and was widely boycotted.

questions.question: Who was the first President of India?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the first President (1950–62).

questions.question: How many fundamental rights are currently guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 fundamental rights after the Right to Property was removed in 1978.

questions.question: The Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) was led by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
questions.explanation: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930.

questions.question: Which is the largest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: The powerhouse of the cell is the:
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce energy (ATP), so they are the cell’s powerhouse.

questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Gandhi in:
questions.explanation: The Non-Cooperation Movement began in 1920.

questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The President nominates 12 members to the Rajya Sabha for expertise in arts, science, etc.

questions.question: The Western Ghats run parallel to which coast of India?
questions.explanation: The Western Ghats run along the western coast.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj?
questions.explanation: Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in 1875.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.explanation: Article 32 is called the "heart and soul" of the Constitution.

questions.question: The "Right to Education" was made a fundamental right by which amendment?
questions.explanation: The 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A — Right to Education.

questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Do or Die"?
questions.explanation: Gandhi gave "Do or Die" during the Quit India Movement.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of MPs and MLAs.

questions.question: The national song of India is:
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" is the national song; "Jana Gana Mana" is the national anthem.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.question: The Thomas Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is a men’s international badminton team event.

questions.question: A money bill can be introduced only in the:
questions.explanation: A money bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: Water boils at what temperature at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard sea-level pressure.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: How many schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Constitution currently has 12 schedules.

questions.question: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
questions.explanation: The President appoints the Chief Justice of India.

questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: The ancient university of Nalanda was located in present-day:
questions.explanation: Nalanda is in present-day Bihar.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as World Environment Day?
questions.explanation: World Environment Day is observed on 5 June.

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: It passes through 8 states but not Odisha.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
questions.explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers Vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.question: Who was the last Governor-General of independent India?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the last and only Indian Governor-General.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: Which acid is present in the human stomach?
questions.explanation: The stomach uses hydrochloric acid for digestion.

questions.question: Emperor Ashoka belonged to which dynasty?
questions.explanation: Ashoka was a Mauryan emperor.

questions.question: The First Battle of Panipat (1526) was fought between Babur and:
questions.explanation: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in 1526, founding the Mughal Empire.

questions.question: The Param Vir Chakra is awarded for:
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest wartime gallantry award.

questions.question: If today is Monday, what day will it be after 32 days?
questions.explanation: 32 mod 7 = 4; Monday + 4 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 9th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 9th letter = I; 9 + 2 = 11th letter = K.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (3, 26), (4, 64), (7, 343), (6, 216)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 3³ = 27, not 26.

questions.question: In a row of 60 students, Ravi is 42nd from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 60 − 42 + 1 = 19.

questions.question: Find the next term: 36, 49, 64, 81, 100, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 6²…10². Next is 11² = 121.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 6, 11, 19, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 14, so 30 + 14 = 44.

questions.question: If FISH is coded as JMWL, how is TREE coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to TREE gives XVII.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 5:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 5:00 the angle is 5 × 30° = 150°.
The relation is squaring: 7² = 49, so 9² = 81.

questions.question: A person walks 6 km East and then 8 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 12 + 2 × 2.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 12 × 2 − 2 = 24 − 2 = 22.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 13, 40, 121, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3 + 1: 121 × 3 + 1 = 364.

questions.question: Complete the series: A, C, E, G, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 2 places, so the next is I.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 13, 31, 12, 23
questions.explanation: 31, 23, 13 are prime numbers; 12 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 2nd letter from the right is the 25th from the left = Y.
The relation is cubing: 4³ = 64, so 4³ = 64.

questions.question: If today is Friday, what day will it be after 42 days?
questions.explanation: 42 mod 7 = 0; Friday + 0 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 6th to the right of the 5th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 5th letter = E; 5 + 6 = 11th letter = K.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (5, 125), (4, 64), (7, 343), (2, 11)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 2³ = 8, not 11.

questions.question: In a row of 41 students, Ravi is 29th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 41 − 29 + 1 = 13.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 2²…6². Next is 7² = 49.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 7, 14, 23, 34, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 13, so 34 + 13 = 47.

questions.question: If FISH is coded as JMWL, how is BIRD coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to BIRD gives FMVH.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.
The relation is squaring: 9² = 81, so 4² = 16.

questions.question: A train 160 m long crosses a pole in 8 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 12 days and B in 4 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/4 = 16/48. Time = 48/16 = 3 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √676.
After a 20% discount, an item costs ₹560. Find its marked price.
Find 10% of 20% of 300.
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5 and their difference is 8. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 2 parts = 8, so each part = 4. Smaller = 3 × 4 = 12.

questions.question: A boat travels 51 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 51/3 = 17 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 17 − 2 = 15 km/h.
